fonseca-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Founded by Francisco Fonseca in the 1890s, the brand is still recognised by the tissue paper in which its cigars are wrapped. Fonseca uses wrapper and filler from Vuelta Abajo, and every size is made totally by hand, some with long filler and some with short. Habanos rates it light: a smooth, gently sweet smoke with buttery, biscuit-like tones, suited to a light meal or a short break.

thirds.notes: A mild, simple start with a syrupy sweetness and soft buttery, biscuit-like notes.
Wood and a light nutmeg spice come in; as the sweetness eases, hints of espresso appear over faint pepper.
The flavours warm and fill out a little, with leather and black pepper toward the close.
